content:
Chapter 543 - 543 School Begins; Registration! (1)

Chapter 543 - 543 School Begins; Registration! (1)

543 School Begins; Registration! (1)

“One, two, three… Wooden figure!”

Everyone rushed toward the stool.

Relying on her petite figure, Lin Xiaoyao sat down almost immediately.

Some of the larger people were not so lucky.

This time, almost half of the people were eliminated.

It had to be said that Lin Xiaoyao was very serious about the game.

Every time, she would use all her strength and speed to sprint forward.

After a few rounds, she had not been eliminated.

At this moment, only Lin Xiaoyao and a man who was about 1.75 meters tall were left in the huge scene.

They allowed the sweat to flow down their foreheads, but their eyes were fixed on the stool without blinking.

The air… seemed to have become heavy.

The final victory would be between the two of them!

The audience standing outside the stadium also became nervous and began to discuss.

“Who do you think will win?”

“Of course, it’s that man! A man’s speed, reaction time, and endurance are better than a woman’s. Moreover, that lady looks so young. She might even still be in high school, so she can’t compare to a man.”

“That’s not necessarily true. I saw that girl’s speed just now.”

“If they win, they can get at least 500 million yuan!”

“500 million? I think they can get at least 600 million!”

As everyone said this, they could not help but look at the stadium with even more focus.

…

Lin Xiaoyao and the man in the stadium felt their hearts beating wildly.

“One, two, three… Wooden figure!”

Almost at the same time, Lin Xiaoyao and the man sat on the stool together.

They were evenly matched!

The two of them slowly stood up and looked at the stool again.

The round began again!

“One, two, three… Wooden figure!”

This time…

Perhaps because the man was too excited, he accidentally tripped.

Lin Xiaoyao seized the opportunity and sat on the stool.

The victor was decided!

“Yay!”

Lin Xiaoyao shouted happily.

In fact, not only was Lin Xiaoyao extremely excited, but the audience outside was also very excited.

“She won!”

“Didn’t I say that the young lady stands a chance at winning?”

“That’s amazing!”

…

At this moment, a loud voice sounded from the broadcast.

“Congratulations to this lady for obtaining the final victory. The prize money is 798,500,000 yuan!”

As soon as he said this, the entire stadium was in an uproar.

Lin Xiaoyao jumped up excitedly.

The man lying on the ground was filled with regret.

Almost, he almost… won 800 million yuan!

After receiving so much prize money, Lin Xiaoyao might have to face reporters. It would be very troublesome if she was surrounded…

However, at this moment, a luxurious private jet flew over from afar. It picked up Lin Xiaoyao and Lin Fan and sped off into the distance under everyone’s gaze.

On the plane, Lin Xiaoyao was still extremely excited.

“Brother, I won! I earned 800 million yuan!”

When she said this, she could not help but dance.

Lin Fan looked at her happy face and smiled. “Yes, you did.”

Then, Lin Xiaoyao threw herself into Lin Fan’s arms and said, “Brother, thank you!”

In her opinion, the reason why Lin Fan spent one billion yuan to organize this game event was to make her happy.

It was great to have such a brother!

Lin Fan said, “What’s there to thank between siblings?”

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Mission completed—host a large-scale Tentacle World event with more than 500 people and receive more than 80% positive comments from the participants. You’ve received five golden packets.]

Mission accomplished!

When Lin Fan heard this, the smile on his face widened.

…

After the event ended, the crowd in the stadium slowly dispersed after a long time.

On Weibo.

Satisfied: [Qing City’s Tentacle World event is really awesome! Just like what was publicized on the internet, the prize money is a billion! I thought it was just a gimmick.]

Liked Chuzheng: [Placing 500 million in cash in a hot air balloon is simply too spectacular!]

Douban: [1,2,3, Wooden Figure, stacking stars, tug-of-war, Tentacles? As long as you complete any game, you’d receive at least 200,000 yuan! Heavens! Even if you don’t win in the end, you still earned a few hundred thousand!]

Great Cool: [I actually forgot to sign up! It feels like I’ve missed out on hundreds of millions!]

On Duty: [I don’t want the hundreds of millions in prize money. But I like to play all those games. So, when is the next game?]

Dusk and Night: [In the end, a girl actually got 790 million. I’m really envious.]

…

As more and more people joined the discussion, the popularity of Tentacle World’s event quickly rose to the top of the hot topic list.

Then, the shares of Naifei Corporation rose by two points, and the shares of Penguin Group rose by one point.

According to the proportion of shares that Lin Fan held, Lin Fan’s assets had increased by 44 billion!

In other words, Lin Fan’s assets had increased by 86 billion after spending one billion on the event!

Of course, regarding these…

Lin Fan did not care at all.
